source: Hunyuan3D-2 teacher meshes generated from Codex-cleaned asset images of the official primal sheets (references/primal_starter_official_2026-10-25); measured, never shipped
base: SPEC_primal_spiky_hair (female regions) for the rest of the head

tie._note: band width includes hair touching the tie — treat as an upper bound; design rule: 2–3 cm wide band at 0.28–0.31 of the tail

gather._note: teacher hair hangs loose (≈110–130°), it does NOT converge on the tie — DESIGN CHOICE for the builder: pull the back/crown clumps toward the root

gates.name: tail
gates.rule: analyze_ponytail.py on the built mesh: length, droop, root height inside learned [p10, p90] (±10 %)

gates.name: taper
gates.rule: radius at the tip ≤ 0.5 × max radius; max radius in learned range

gates.name: tie
gates.rule: segment_mesh.py --kind hair finds exactly one tie mold within 0.2–0.4 of the tail from the root

gates.name: behind
gates.rule: tail centre ≥ 8 cm behind the head centre; never in front of the ears
